title: THE WAY TO 2ND KYU

techniques: Jodan ko uke (Upper level wrist block)
Jodan oi zuki, jodan furi zuki
Jodan oi zuki, chudan gyaku zuki, jodan kaki zuki
Neko ashi dachi, kaishu sandan uke
Basic blocks with partner – jodan ko uke
Chudan yoko uke, jodan kagi zuki

knowledge.meaning: Open-hand kata; faster, flowing kata with the tanden closing mainly at the moment of impact.
Closed-hand kata; kata performed with constant dynamic tension, breath control and focus in the tanden.

knowledge.term: Shodan, nidan, sandan, yondan, godan, rokudan, shichidan, hachidan, kudan, judan
knowledge.meaning: First through tenth dan, the black-belt rank levels.

history: Sensei Kanryo Higaonna's nickname was "ashi (legs) no Higaonna" because of his superb kicking techniques
Both Sensei Kanryo Higaonna and Chojun Miyagi taught karate at Naha Shogyo Koko (Naha Commercial High School)
Sensei Chojun Miyagi created Tensho kata in 1926 from the Chinese form called Rokkishu
Sensei Kanryo Higaonna is the among the first to teach karate publicly
